scientific_boundary: The common-digit simulation lemma and cylinder-path certificate are exact. Existence of dominant shadows is finite through complexity 25 and does not prove the all-depth adjacent-shadow inclusion, phase-complexity divergence, exclusion of eventual period two, or Rule 30 center nonperiodicity.

theorem.common_digit_simulation: For adjacent frontier states q and p, M(q) subset M(p) implies every base-four lift digit available to q is available to p.
theorem.dominant_shadow_path: A shared cylinder whose projected adjacent pairs satisfy mask containment at every digit has an exact level-(k-1) dominant shadow.
theorem.three_return_consequence: A dominant shadow for a three-return occurrence rules out minimum complexity at the current level for that base cylinder.
